worldcombat.skill.softboiled.summary: Lays an egg that holds a heal; it hatches a moment later for about half of maximum health. The egg stays in the world and can be smashed by an enemy before it hatches (then the heal is lost). With Share on it is handed to a wounded nearby ally instead, at the cost of your own heal.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.use.0: Leave a heal nearby and take it in your own time
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.use.1: Lay the egg somewhere safe, then come back for it
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.use.2: Give the egg to a wounded companion
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.description: Lays an egg at your feet that hatches after %2$s to restore %1$s of the beneficiary's maximum health; the egg stays in the world with 6 HP and can be smashed before it hatches.
Wind-up %1$s and recovery %2$s, shortened by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.stance.shar: Share: only castable while a wounded ally is in range; hands the egg to the nearest wounded ally within %1$s blocks, who restores %2$s of their own maximum health, at the cost of the caster's own heal.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.stance.self: Self: only castable while below full health; the egg is kept and hatches to restore %1$s of your own maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
On: hand the egg to a wounded nearby ally who heals by the same fraction, at the cost of the caster's own heal. Off: keep it for yourself.
The companion lays an egg below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher lays one at the first wound.
world_combat.move.softboiled.text.shared: The egg goes to a companion (+%1$s)
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.description: If the beneficiary has left or is at full health when the egg hatches, the heal is wasted.
